item_name: Rothco Foam Sleeping Pad With Ties
item_short_desc: Prepare to camp in comfort with Rothco’s Foam Sleeping Pad with Ties. This essential camping accessory aids relaxation and provides protection from the elements, keeping dampness away from the body while resting on the ground. Featuring built-in ties for hassle-free transportation and easy storage, this lightweight sleeping pad measures 71 inches x 24 inches and is 3/8 inch thick. The lightweight pad is perfect for your favorite campsite or hiking adventures.
